title: 第389章 到底哪里出事了？
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秘境外。

秦然正无聊等待着。

突然，心脏猛跳了一下，一股隐隐的不安感涌上心头。

“SS级生存危机要来了吗？”

他警惕起来，神识扫向四面八方，但此地依旧平静。

目之所及，只能看见遍地的狐族尸体，刚才香香和小灵儿没来得及杀完的那些，也都被他补刀，没留一个活口……

“哎呀，大惊小怪的，这里没人～”

小云云出现在肩膀上，打着哈欠，无语的翻了个大白眼……

第八层玉台上。

小灵儿还在苦苦支撑着，瘦弱的身躯颤抖得越来越厉害。

模糊的视线中，她艰难的抬起手，想要摸摸眼前的秦然。

明明很近很近，可她却怎么也摸不到，灵魂的缺失下，眼前人影开始晃动、虚幻，越来越不真实。

“呕！”少女嘴角溢出的血越来越多。

“陛下…我，我好像有一点疼。”

“宝贝别怕！很快就好了，你再坚持一下，放松，对，再放松……”

少女的小脸上已没有一丁点人色。

她的脑海中，一幅幅画面不受控制的涌了出来。

从宫中初遇，被洪烈禁锢扔到秦然脚边开始…到不听话被吊在房梁…再到第一次陪他睡觉……

她的意识明明已经模糊了。

但此刻，这些画面却是前所未有的清晰。

她脑海中的其他记忆已经全部都消失了，只剩这一幅幅开局苦涩，却让她毕生难忘的记忆画面。

“陛下，你刚叫我宝贝……”少女近乎无意识的呢喃着，眼皮已经越来越沉重。

她的话没有得到回应，只能听见耳畔急促的呼吸声。

“陛下，好疼的，我好像要坚持不住了，不过…我还可以忍一忍。”

“陛下，如果我晕过去了，你不要抛下我好吗？”

“陛下，其实我一直有话想跟你说，在你身边我好自卑的，以后…以后你能不能多关注我一点点，就一点点就行了。”

“陛下，每次看你和其他姐姐说说笑笑，我心里都会不舒服，我偷偷问过宫女，她们告诉我这种感觉可能是嫉妒，我…真的在嫉妒其他姐姐吗？你会不会觉得我很坏。”

“陛下，我好想给你生小狐狸…如果以后我们的宝宝出生了，你说会是小狐狸，还是会和你一样好看的人类呢…不过，他也不用很好看，就算他丑一点，我也会很喜欢很喜欢的……”

“云江仙…我好困…我可能要睡一会儿了…求求你…带我回家好不好……”

少女的眼皮，终于抬不起来了。

无尽的空虚和已经麻木的剧痛，将她柔弱的娇躯紧紧包裹，她仅剩的意识仿佛坠入了无底深渊，不断的下坠…下坠……

Page (1/3)

Outside the secret realm.

Qin Ran was waiting boredly.

Suddenly, my heart skipped a beat, and a vague feeling of uneasiness surged into my heart.

"Is the SS-class survival crisis coming?"

He became vigilant and his consciousness swept in all directions, but the place remained calm.

As far as the eye could see, he could only see the corpses of the Fox clan all over the place. Those that Xiangxiang and Xiao Ling'er didn't have time to kill just now were all killed by him, leaving no one alive...

"Oh, what a fuss, no one is here~"

Xiao Yunyun appeared on the shoulder, yawned, and rolled his eyes speechlessly...

On the jade platform on the eighth floor.

Little Ling'er was still struggling to hold on, and her thin body was shaking more and more.

In her blurred vision, she raised her hand with difficulty, wanting to touch Kieran in front of her.

It was obviously very close, but she couldn't touch it. Without a soul, the figure in front of her began to shake and become unreal, becoming increasingly unreal.

"Ugh!" More and more blood spilled from the corner of the girl's mouth.

"Your Majesty...I, I seem to be in a little pain."

"Don't be afraid, baby! It will be fine soon. Just hold on a little longer and relax, yes, relax again..."

There was no trace of human color on the girl's face.

In her mind, pictures emerged uncontrollably.

From the first time they met in the palace, to being imprisoned by Hong Lie and thrown at Qin Ran's feet... to being hung from the beam for disobedience... to the first time sleeping with him...

Her consciousness was obviously blurred.

But at this moment, these pictures are clearer than ever.

All other memories in her mind have disappeared, leaving only this memory scene that started out bitterly, but will be unforgettable for her whole life.

"Your Majesty, you just called me baby..." the girl murmured almost unconsciously, her eyelids becoming heavier and heavier.

There was no response to her words, and she could only hear the rapid breathing in her ears.

"Your Majesty, it hurts so much. I seem to be unable to hold on, but... I can still bear it."

"Your Majesty, if I faint, please don't abandon me, okay?"

"Your Majesty, actually I have always wanted to tell you something. I feel so inferior around you. From now on... can you pay more attention to me, just a little bit."

"Your Majesty, every time I see you talking and laughing with other sisters, I feel uncomfortable. I secretly asked the palace maids, and they told me that this feeling may be jealousy. Am I... really jealous of other sisters? Do you think I am bad?"

"Your Majesty, I really want to give you a little fox... If our baby is born in the future, do you think it will be a little fox or a human being as beautiful as you... However, he doesn't have to be very good-looking. Even if he is a bit uglier, I will like him very much..."

"Yunjiangxian...I'm so sleepy...I may have to sleep for a while...Please...take me home..."

The girl's eyelids finally couldn't be raised.

Endless emptiness and numbing pain tightly wrapped her delicate body, and her remaining consciousness seemed to fall into the bottomless abyss, falling... falling...
